labels.spinPool: Drop pool (was the Spin pool): Snowball Drop entries in, Drop winners paid out; the game server sends from it
labels.slotsPool: Slots pool: Big Hat entries in, Big Hat winners paid out; the game server sends from it
labels.lotteryPool: Lottery wallet: ticket money in (10% burned first); winners paid by hand by Cody for now
labels.treasury: Treasury: skims from the pools; 50% of level and Store purchases
labels.player: Test player: buys runs, tickets and levels in the tests
labels.codyAdmin: Stand-in for Cody's admin wallet (signs pause/settings/lottery-paid on devnet); his Phantom replaces it at launch
labels.admin: Test-token authority: makes the test SANTA (not used by the game)
labels.funder: Pays devnet setup fees (devnet SOL only)
labels.testPlayers: Fake players for testing (devnet only): SOL for fees from the funder, test SANTA; keys in <SANTA_KEYS>/players/
